lines.text: Judah was exiled to Babylon for unfaithfulness, and the first to resettle were Israelites, priests, Levites, and temple servants.
The Benjamites came with 956 relatives, and the priests came with 1,760 relatives, able men for God's house.
Gatekeepers stood on all four sides, relatives served for seven days, and the chief gatekeepers guarded the house at night.

wrong_details.wrong: Gatekeepers stood on all four sides, relatives served for three months
